set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O03.3
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer with institutional operator
Scope: Qualify H03.1’s reusable backup engine on the actual independently operated institutional backup medium, including physical failure-domain/access/retention assumptions.

Work kind: mixed
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Capture a catalog/blob-consistent set with manifests, integrity hashes, versions and required policy checkpoint references; incomplete copies never appear successful.
2. Schedule copying to the selected independent backup medium with documented access/encryption controls, retention and capacity; qualify interruption/retry and ongoing writes.
3. Record successful backup time, age and verification results for alerts; corrupted or missing objects invalidate the bundle.

Verification: Automated backup/retry/corruption fixtures plus an actual selected-medium receipt before institutional handover.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Institutional backup medium for final qualification

Source/contracts:
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O03.1: bd-01M4W5P9194RGNP7DFGHB7ZK09
- O01.2: bd-01M4W5P7PW6P6NZVCD0TEMRKKP
- H03.1: bd-01M4X8MA9J2FXA82A9RVB85YD9
- SITE01.2: bd-01M4W5P46THC7WFA4FD0B1A68Z

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O03.3: Automate verified off-host catalog and blob backups
